edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) before _lp is written.
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when deducting allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner in approve.
msg.sender must hold the role admin to grant a role.
msg.sender must hold the role admin to revoke a role.
msg.sender must hold SNAPSHOT_ROLE to call snapshot.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() before renouncing.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() before transferring ownership.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) supplies the sender address in _transfer.
burn uses _msgSender() as the account whose tokens are destroyed.
burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance validation.
constructor mints to _msgSender and grants it DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and SNAPSHOT_ROLE.
setLP writes the admin-controlled _lp address.
setLP reads _roles through hasRole to authorize the caller.
transfer branch compares recipient with the privileged _lp address.
transfer calls _transfer to move tokens.
transferFrom branch compares recipient with the privileged _lp address.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer calls _burn when the burn fee applies.
_transfer compares _totalSupply against the minimum supply to decide the burn.
_transfer compares _totalSupply against _minimumSupply.
_transfer multiplies amount by BURN_RATE to compute the burn fee.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances[account].
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to _balances[account].
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) after onlyOwner check.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
grantRole mutates _roles via _grantRole.
revokeRole mutates _roles via _revokeRole.
approve delegates to _approve.
burn calls _burn on the caller.
burnFrom calls _burn on the target account.
snapshot requires the SNAPSHOT_ROLE hash.
snapshot reads _roles through hasRole to authorize the caller.
sendValue performs a low-level call with all gas to a recipient, enabling reentrant callbacks before state finalization.
The transfer gate depends on the admin-controlled _lp address, silently blocking transfers to it.
recipient parameter is compared with _lp inside transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer.

spender parameter flows into _approve.

account parameter is burned in burnFrom.

symbol parameter is stored as the token symbol.
amount parameter is minted, increasing _totalSupply.
remainingAmount is computed from amount minus the burn fee in _transfer.
burnAmount is computed as amount*BURN_RATE/PERCENTS_DIVIDER in _transfer.
cached msgSender receives minted supply and the default admin role.
currentId is the snapshot id returned by snapshot().

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a direct argument of transfer and is only meaningful inside it.
amount is a direct argument of transfer forwarded to _transfer.
sender is a direct argument of transferFrom.
spender is a direct argument of approve.
newOwner is the sole argument written into _owner by transferOwnership.
account is the argument whose tokens burnFrom destroys.
role is the argument used for the admin lookup in grantRole.
decimals is the constructor argument assigned to _decimals.
name is the constructor argument assigned to the token name.
symbol is the constructor argument assigned to the token symbol.
amount is the constructor argument minted to the deployer.
remainingAmount only exists within _transfer to hold post-fee amount.
burnAmount only exists within _transfer as the computed fee.
msgSender is the constructor-local cache of _msgSender().
currentId only exists within snapshot as the new snapshot id.
